title: River Client 0.3.2
items: Added: The Booster cape, for people boosting the River Discord for as long as they boost. Run /boostercape in Discord, then enter the code in Cosmetics.
Improved: River runs lighter. The aurora, Keystrokes, nametags, River capes and the entity checks do far less work each frame.
Added: Freelook turns itself off on any server that blocks the Freelook mod, not only on River's own list.
Changed: HUD style presets are new and set the whole look: Frosted glass, Frosted with border, Dark, Dark rounded, Faint, Outline only and Text only.
Fixed: Glass panels showed light specks in their rounded corners.
Fixed: The Spotify bar flickered with the cursor near its edge, and lyrics in it could be cut off or have big gaps between words. Long lines now slide along with the singing.
Fixed: Freelook no longer turns on on Hypixel or MCPVP.club, which do not allow it. Pressing its key there says so once.

Fixed: A crash at start, "Failed to load class file", after which only Repair helped. The launcher could rewrite River's file while the game was starting; it now never touches it while the game runs, and replaces it in one step.
Added: Minimize on the launch screen (or Esc) shrinks it into a small card, so you can use the launcher while the game starts.
Improved: The Windows installer is back to about 230 MB instead of 1 GB. It carries River for Minecraft 1.21.11; other versions download the first time you play them.
Improved: The Mac and Linux downloads are smaller for the same reason.
Added: The standalone mod updates itself. It downloads the new version in the background, checks it is a real River release, and switches to it the next time you start Minecraft.
Fixed: With FancyMenu installed, River's main menu no longer covers FancyMenu's custom menus.

Added: A new pause menu in the style of River's title screen, with your player beside it while the camera slowly circles them. Your music stays on screen with its controls, and the square buttons open River's menu, Wardrobe, Friends and the game's own pause menu with every mod's buttons. Settings has River pause menu and Pause menu camera to turn either off.
Improved: Zoom eases in and out like a camera, scrolling to zoom further glides instead of jumping, the zoom key reacts the moment you press it, and the mouse slows to match.
Changed: The Spotify module is now a small bar with the song's album cover and its name. Hover or click it in a menu for the full player with its controls.
Changed: Lyrics are part of the Spotify module now. Turn them on in its settings; On screen shows the line being sung in the Spotify bar in place of the song name. The separate lyrics bar is gone.
Added: On Mac, the Spotify module and Lyrics read Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube Music directly, album art included, without River Launcher.
Changed: Every River player now has the River badge, and it is smaller, the height of the letters next to it. Cinematic mode hides everyone's badges on your screen; other players still see yours.
Changed: The None card in Cosmetics shows River's red X.
Improved: Security. Links only ever open as web pages, the launcher window can no longer be sent to a website, and file actions stay inside River's own folders.
